title: Sentence builder
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Friends of nature; Layla in the snow; Salem at the zoo
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: sentence builder)
intro: Lesson 11: Complete sentences: the nominal sentence. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Examples
points: الجَوُّ بَارِدٌ: the weather is cold
الشَّجَرَةُ طَوِيلَةٌ: the tree is tall
النَّهْرُ كَبِيرٌ: the river is big

blocks.title: Sort into: Boy word: كَبِيرٌ / Girl word: كَبِيرَةٌ
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Boy word: كَبِيرٌ, Girl word: كَبِيرَةٌ.
blocks.answer: Boy word: كَبِيرٌ: البَيْتُ; الجَبَلُ. Girl word: كَبِيرَةٌ: الشَّجَرَةُ; الزَّهْرَةُ

box.title: Three sentences. Underline the mubtada' in one colour and the khabar in another.

keywords.def: a sentence that starts with a noun
the subject: what we talk about
the news: what we say about it

questions.q: Make a sentence: the flower (الزَّهْرَة) + beautiful (جَمِيل).
The mubtada' in القِرْدُ صَغِيرٌ is ...

Sentence builder on the pupil PDF: join six nouns to the right khabar (big, small, cold, beautiful, tall, white), then write three sentences and underline the mubtada' in one colour and the khabar in another.
questions.a: For example: البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ، الشَّجَرَةُ طَوِيلَةٌ، الثَّلْجُ أَبْيَضُ

questions.q: Extend: write a sentence about the weather today.
Stretch: why does the khabar have no ال?
questions.a: Because it is the new information about the mubtada'.

questions.q: In الثَّلْجُ أَبْيَضُ, the khabar is ...
questions.a: A) أَبْيَضُ. The khabar tells us about the snow: white.
